keywords.def: tax on earnings above the personal allowance
a payment from earnings that funds the state pension and benefits
the amount you can earn before paying income tax

questions.q: Core: Payslip sheet (pupil PDF): find gross, each deduction and net pay on two payslips.
questions.a: Values read correctly from both payslips.

questions.q: Extend: Calculate take-home pay for a £30,000 salary (basic rate only).
Stretch: In the portal response box, explain why the tax system is called 'progressive'.
questions.a: People pay a higher share as income rises: allowance, then 20%, then higher rates.
B) Take-home pay after deductions. Net is what is left after tax, NI and other deductions.

questions.q: The personal allowance is... A) a bonus B) earnings you can receive before income tax C) a pension
questions.a: B) earnings you can receive before income tax

questions.q: Big question: will a £24,000 job pay you £24,000?
questions.a: No: about £20,800 after income tax and NI.
